invalidString.datetime: Enter a valid date and time.

runtimeSpec.textHidden: Text must not contain control or bidirectional formatting characters.
runtimeSpec.textTooLong: Text must be at most {{maxBytes}} bytes.
runtimeSpec.textPadded: Text must not be blank or have leading or trailing spaces.
runtimeSpec.numberNotCanonical: Use a whole number or a decimal between 0.000001 and 1e15.
runtimeSpec.modelIdPadded: Model ids must not be blank or have leading or trailing spaces.
runtimeSpec.modelIdMultiline: Model ids must be a single line.
runtimeSpec.routeInvalid: A route must start with a single / and contain no .., //, ?, #, backslash or encoded . or /.
runtimeSpec.urlScheme: Only http and https are allowed.
runtimeSpec.urlExtras: No user info, query or fragment.
runtimeSpec.urlHost: The host must be localhost or an IP literal.
runtimeSpec.urlPrefix: The API prefix must be a plain path.
runtimeSpec.authHeader: A header name is required exactly for mode header.
runtimeSpec.gibRange: Must be more than 0 and at most 1e6 GiB.
runtimeSpec.perNodeEntries: Provide one entry for every node of the runtime, or exactly one for all of them.
runtimeSpec.fabricSingleNode: Only a multi-node runtime names a fabric.
runtimeSpec.serviceStatus: Service runtimes need a status command (exit 0 alive, exit 3 stopped).
runtimeSpec.interactiveStatus: Interactive commands need a status command.
runtimeSpec.interactiveService: An interactive start or afterJoin needs management service.
runtimeSpec.specTooLarge: A runtime definition is at most {{maxBytes}} bytes as canonical JSON.
runtimeSpec.addressOrLaunch: A runtime has exactly one of address (always-on) or launch (startable).
runtimeSpec.servingFields: A runtime that serves models declares api, engine and modelType.
runtimeSpec.serviceFields: A service (no models) has no api, engine or modelType.
runtimeSpec.serviceExtras: A service has no metrics reader or media expansion.
runtimeSpec.servingReadiness: A runtime that serves models needs an HTTP readiness check.
runtimeSpec.serviceReadiness: A service needs an HTTP readiness check or a status/health command on every node.
runtimeSpec.transcriptionModelType: A transcription profile needs modelType transcription.
runtimeSpec.segmentedMaxSeconds: The segmented adapter allows at most {{maxSeconds}} seconds per turn.
runtimeSpec.metricNamesUnique: Metric command names must be unique.
runtimeSpec.metricCommandsTooLarge: Node metric commands are at most {{maxBytes}} bytes together.
runtimeSpec.fabricIp: Expected the node's IP address on this fabric (e.g. 10.0.0.5 or fd00::5).
runtimeSpec.fabricOnce: A node joins each fabric once.
runtimeSpec.portRangeReversed: The port range must not be reversed.
runtimeSpec.gpuUnifiedVram: A unified GPU shares system memory: omit vramGb.
runtimeSpec.gpuDiscreteVram: A discrete GPU needs vramGb (or unified: true when it shares system memory).
